title: The useRef Hook
description: Learn how to access DOM elements and persist values across renders.

data.text: **useRef** serves two purposes: accessing DOM elements directly and storing mutable values that don't cause re-renders when changed.

data.title: DOM Reference

data.text: useRef values persist across renders but don't trigger re-renders when changed. Useful for storing previous values or IDs.

data.title: Previous Value
Ref Object
data.text: useRef returns an object with a `.current` property. You can read and write to `ref.current` at any time.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: useRef accesses DOM elements via ref attribute
Persists values across renders without causing re-renders
Use for mutable values that shouldn't trigger updates
data.takeaway: useRef is essential for DOM access and persisting values.
